claims.text: Rafe Dunmow flagged that the September statement total looks $900 higher than the line items add up to.
Cleo Vantongeren confirmed the discrepancy; billing corrected some usage late in the month.
Payment is held until the corrected statement arrives.
Cleo Vantongeren to send a corrected statement by October 9.
Unresolved statement is a risk for Pennyroyal's audit next month.
